response.overview: This video continues where Picture Product left off by including the music videos for the latest Buck-Tick releases at the time.  There are bonus extra hidden items in the menu for selecting a song (AKA easter eggs). There is a link on each member to footage of their photo shoot for the book of photos that this video comes with. This is around the time most members were involved in a solo project, hence Atsushi Okuno from Wild Wise Apes is visible during U-ta's photo shoot.  A few copies included a mark that you are a winner ("atari" in Japanese) and the prize would be a panel picture of your choice.
response.title: Buck-Tick: Picture Product II
